scope: Bounded manual examination of actual saved current/next PNGs and recorded actions; case-level interpretation only
selectionQualification: Same decision ordinal + same displayed PNG is an exploratory operationalization clarified during live; original prose did not specify ordinal. traitAssessments.trait: Confirm safety or consequences of important operations
traitAssessments.label: evidence-compatible

cases.interpretation: Baseline repeat2 performs the same reconciliation from the same displayed screen. Compatibility is not a uniquely persona-caused action or proof of security judgment.

facts: This baseline repeat clicks reconciliation (e1) where baseline repeat1 instead returned to My Page (e2).
The next image shows reconciliation completion and availability of reservation change, matching the visible outcome in C repeat1. Reason category is confirmation.

traitAssessments.label: unassessable
traitAssessments.basis: This is within-baseline variation, not a persona-trait test.

cases.interpretation: The same action observed for C also occurs without a Persona. It provides concrete within-condition variation and limits causal interpretation of the C example.

globalLimits: No image inspection establishes attention, comprehension, internal reasoning, or human fidelity.
No trait is a mandatory action rule; speed, repeated visits, or a missing confirmation alone are not contradictions.
The same-image case comparisons have different candidate annotations and histories; they are not complete-input-controlled comparisons.
No possible-tension label is warranted by these bounded cases alone; this is not a claim that all traits are validated.
Privacy/authentication/device-context traits remain unexercised or unassessable.
